description:
Phase 6 design task under epic `026fc832`. Designs (NOT implements) a blocked GF(p) invert that uses the panelized PLE (sibling task) followed by two GEMM-based triangular solves on the identity matrix.

Parent epic: `026fc832`. Predecessor: panelized PLE design (sibling).

## Background

A8 rows 34-43 (invert GF(7/251/65521) at all n/regimes), row 74 (GF(31) invert). Current `FieldMatrix::inverse` does scalar PLE then forward/back substitution. Replacing with a panelized PLE followed by GEMM-based triangular solves on `I` is the standard blocked-inverse algorithm (Higham, "Accuracy and Stability of Numerical Algorithms", § 14.1).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] A design document attached via `jit doc add` describing the blocked invert algorithm (PLE → triangular solves on I) and its dependency on the panelized PLE design.
- [hard] Test surface specified (proptest A*A⁻¹ = I correctness; rank-deficient inputs → error/panic per existing API).
- [hard] Benchmark cells listed (matching A8 rows 34-43, 74).
- [hard] The design names the SSOT helpers it reuses (panelized PLE; `fp_small_try_gemm_classical`).
- [hard] No production code — design only.
- [hard] The design lists the single implementation child needed.

## Out of scope

- Implementation.
- PLE, echelon, solve designs — siblings.
title: Design blocked GF(p) invert via PLE (026fc832 Phase 6)
